_comment: JOINT_POSITION composite controller for Rover2026. Selected in Phase 0 spike (TRACKER §6, §19) after OSC_POSE failed convergence on this 6-DOF arm. Per-joint delta input in [-1,1] mapped to ±0.05 rad/step at 20 Hz. Over-damped P-D tracker (kp=100, damping_ratio=1.5) suppresses overshoot; matches Moteus position-mode interface for sim-to-real fidelity.
